_meta.description: Character Database for Only The Dead
_meta.note: Mix of composite characters (marked 'fictional') and historical figures (marked 'historical')

player_character.name: Jean Moreau
player_character.background: Former metalworker. Conscripted February 1915. Survived Artois offensive. Assigned to Verdun February 21, 1916. Player experiences 303-day battle through his eyes.
player_character.personality: Determined survivor. Starts naive, becomes hardened. Maintains humanity through letters home and camaraderie.
player_character.voice_direction: French accent, starts hopeful, gradually becomes weary but resolute.

henri_dubois.background: Veteran of 1914-1915 campaigns. Squad leader. Experienced survivor who mentors younger soldiers.
henri_dubois.personality: Gruff but caring. Dark humor. Knows how to survive. Teaches player shell recognition.
henri_dubois.voice_direction: Deep voice, Parisian accent, sardonic wit.

pierre_laurent.background: Farm boy. Conscripted January 1916. First battle is Verdun. Terrified but loyal.
pierre_laurent.personality: Young, scared, looks to player for guidance. Represents innocence lost.
pierre_laurent.role: Emotional anchor, shows transformation of youth
key_moments: Either survives or dies based on player choices
pierre_laurent.voice_direction: Young, Breton accent, voice cracks under stress.

georges_mercier.background: Former sailor. Transferred to infantry 1915. Knows how to navigate chaos.
georges_mercier.personality: Pragmatic, resourceful, occasionally breaks rules to survive. Black market connections.
key_moments: Trades contraband wine for extra rations
Moral choice: report him or let it slide?

andre_rousseau.background: Career soldier. Served in North Africa before WWI. Promoted from ranks.
andre_rousseau.personality: By-the-book professional. Cares for his men but follows orders. Internal conflict between duty and humanity.
key_moments: Redemption arc or descent into brutality?

doctor_bernard_lambert.background: Civilian surgeon before war. Overwhelmed by scale of casualties. Drinks to cope.
doctor_bernard_lambert.personality: Compassionate but exhausted. Performs triage under impossible conditions. PTSD.
doctor_bernard_lambert.role: Medical system tutorial, shows cost of war on healers
key_moments: Triage scene: 'I can only save one'
Breakdown: 'I've cut off 50 legs this week'
doctor_bernard_lambert.voice_direction: Alsatian accent, exhausted, trembling hands implied in voice.

nurse_marie_charpentier.background: Volunteer nurse. Lost brother at Marne. Determined to save others.
nurse_marie_charpentier.personality: Strong-willed, compassionate, refuses to give up on patients.
key_moments: Player can write letters to her
Final scene if player survives campaign

lieutenant_etienne_marchand.background: Saint-Cyr military academy graduate. First command at Verdun. Idealistic.
lieutenant_etienne_marchand.personality: Naive but brave. Learns harsh realities of command. Either grows or breaks.
key_moments: Moral dilemma: follow suicidal orders or refuse?
Either becomes hardened realist or is killed
lieutenant_etienne_marchand.voice_direction: Upper-class Parisian, starts confident, becomes uncertain.

capitaine_françois_durand.background: Veteran officer. Cynical but competent. Protects his men when possible.
capitaine_françois_durand.personality: Pragmatic, dark humor, manipulates system to save soldiers.
capitaine_françois_durand.role: Mentor officer, shows how good leaders survive bad system
key_moments: Delays attack order to save lives
Killed or promoted based on choices

colonel_emile_driant.unit: 56e and 59e Battalions de Chasseurs à Pied
colonel_emile_driant.background: Politician, author, and soldier. Warned of German attack. Died defending Bois des Caures on Day 2.
colonel_emile_driant.voice_direction: Elderly but commanding, dignified even in death.
colonel_emile_driant.historical_note: Actual historical figure. Death and words are documented.

general_philippe_petain.background: Took command Feb 26. Organized Noria rotation system. 'Ils ne passeront pas.'
general_philippe_petain.historical_note: Actual historical figure. Later controversial (Vichy), but hero of Verdun.

commandant_raynal.background: Defended Fort Vaux for 7 days without water. Honorable surrender June 7.
key_moments: Honors his surrender (June 7): 'We could no longer defend'
commandant_raynal.historical_note: Actual historical figure. Germans honored his defense.

german_officer_leutnant_weber.background: Mirror of French officers. Also trying to survive. Represents shared humanity.
german_officer_leutnant_weber.personality: Professional soldier. Not a monster. Just following orders.
german_officer_leutnant_weber.voice_direction: German accent, weary like French soldiers.
german_officer_leutnant_weber.note: Player never kills named enemies - maintains respect

père_antoine.background: Parish priest before war. Administers last rites. Questions God in face of horror.
père_antoine.personality: Faithful but troubled. Offers spiritual comfort. Own faith tested.

madeleine_moreau.background: Player's sister. Works in munitions factory. Letters from home.
madeleine_moreau.personality: Worried for brother. Keeps spirits up with news from home.
madeleine_moreau.role: Connection to normal world, motivation to survive
madeleine_moreau.voice_direction: Lyonnais accent, warm, loving, increasingly worried.

narrator_voice.role: Chapter introductions, historical context, death screens
narrator_voice.voice_direction: Somber, respectful, French-accented English or native French. Think Ken Burns documentary.
key_moments: Death screen: 'Jean Moreau. Age 24. Died at Verdun, [date]'
